summary: Bearer gains Extension 1/Refresh Charge x3 (m) without using purchased Extension; other sources of Extension cannot be used while worn.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Does not use up any purchased instances of Extension.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Other sources of Extension (e.g. purchased Extension) may not be used while Amplification is worn.

restrictions.note: Other sources of Extension may not be utilized while Amplification is worn (a drawback for a bearer who has purchased Extension).

references.name: Extension
references.note: Other sources of Extension are blocked while Amplification is worn.

clarifications.text: The granted Extension is separate from, and does not use up, any Extension the bearer purchased.
